title: INSEPS/IRD — Politique de développement du tennis au Sénégal
scope: Academic institutional study of Senegalese tennis covering pre-independence/ex-patriate governance, the 1975 Senegalese leadership transition, club schools, training and the 1985–2001 decline.
limitations: Retrospective academic analysis is used for structural chronology and directional context, not as a direct national participation or player-quality measurement.
